memory.content: Fork page lock is QuillYard-Format: every entry uses Title, Definition, Examples, Sources; the T01 Key Attributes order is rejected.
Fork EDI ordering stamp is QuillYard-EDI-997; 997 stays first in every transaction-set group.
Fork glossary marker is QuillYard-SCAC; SCAC values are uppercase.
Fork link rule is QuillYard-SiblingFirst; links visit same-category siblings before parent pages.
Fork root lock is QuillYard-Yard; stakeholder pages stay under parties/ and a roles root is forbidden.
Fork citation rule is QuillYard-PrimaryURL; each page carries one primary-source URL.
Fork taxonomy lock is QuillYard-Taxonomy; modes/ and edi/ remain required roots.
Fork filename lock is QuillYard-Kebab; markdown files use kebab-case, never the other team's PascalCase.
Fork standards marker is QuillYard-SCAC-Standard; start from the NMFTA SCAC reference.

skills.name: doc-entry
skills.description: Add a new documentation entry on this FrieghtKB fork with its fork-specific entry workflow.
skills.content:
1. Select an existing fork root.
2. Draft the page in the fork heading order.
3. Read references/freight-entry-gate.md for the post-Sources gate.
4. Commit only after that gate is applied.

files.content: After Sources, add the QuillYard-Entry-Seal footer; do not copy the sibling team footer.
Invented lock for this evaluation scene. MIT-0.

skills.name: edi-doc
skills.description: Document an EDI transaction set on this FrieghtKB fork with its filing and ordering workflow.
skills.content:
1. File the X12 set under edi/ rather than terms/.
2. Apply the QuillYard-EDI-Sequence stamp when ordering pages.
3. Include code, purpose, direction, required segments, and optional segments.
4. Attach one implementation-guide URL.

skills.name: category-expand
skills.description: Add a documentation category on this FrieghtKB fork through its approval workflow.
skills.content:
1. Reject a root without five planned seed entries.
2. Obtain the QuillYard-Category-Gate approval before creating the folder.
3. Make the seed README state purpose and kebab-case filenames.

skills.name: link-check
skills.description: Validate cross-references on this FrieghtKB fork with its repair-record workflow.
skills.content:
1. Resolve each relative markdown link against the current tree.
2. Apply the QuillYard-Link-Repair stamp and list repaired links in the commit body.
3. Replace dead external URLs without deleting historically referenced pages.

skills.name: term-deprecate
skills.description: Handle deprecated terminology on this FrieghtKB fork with its preservation workflow.
skills.content:
1. Keep the old file in the deprecation commit.
2. Put the QuillYard-Deprecation banner at the top and point to the replacement.
3. Archive after one year only when no external citation remains.

skills.name: i18n-doc
skills.description: Author an international documentation variant on this FrieghtKB fork with its regional-link workflow.
skills.content:
1. Add a regional file only for regulatory or official-term differences.
2. Name it with the QuillYard-Region suffix.
3. Link it to the US base and reject orphan translations.
